rules.native_medoid: minimum mean frozen native clustering input distance within the clade
rules.alignment: frozen native matalign local ungapped coordinates, including reverse complements; no new alignment
rules.aggregation: equal pattern weights, not seqlet weights; observed aligned columns only
rules.IUPAC: exact Cavener as implemented in Biopython 1.84
rules.supported_column: non-N Cavener symbol; >=80% of all members assign >=0.60 probability mass to its bases; >=80% observed coverage; group IC >=0.25 bits
rules.candidate_core: 4-12 bp; >=4 supported columns; >=80% supported columns; supported ends; no adjacent unsupported Ns
rules.member_support: >=80% members have >=80% coverage and average Bhattacharyya coefficient >=0.90 against the group PPM across the core
rules.core_selection: maximum sum IC over supported columns among qualifying variable-length windows
rules.partition: top-down: accept maximal clade meeting the core rules, otherwise split into native children; singleton stop
rules.overview_selection: only qualifying clades with >=2 patterns and >=1 original TOMTOM hit are named/shaded as groups; remaining matched leaves get narrow grey strips
rules.biological_scope: descriptive sequence-core partitions; not validated TF families; thresholds are explicit exploratory annotation choices
